name: パステルドリーム
css: .roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; border: 8px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px #ffd1dc, 0 10px 30px rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.4), inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); margin: 0 !important; }
.pointer { position: absolute; top: 30px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 32px; height: 40px; z-index: 25; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 5px rgba(255, 105, 180, 0.4)); }

.pointer::after { content: ''; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #ff8da1, #ffbfd3); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff; clip-path: path('M 0 0 Q 16 4 32 0 L 16 40 Z'); }

.center-circle { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 100px; height: 100px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #ffffff, #ffe0e9); border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #ffb8d4; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 105, 180, 0.3), inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); z-index: 30; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; pointer-events: auto !important; cursor: pointer; -webkit-app-region: no-drag; transition: transform 0.1s ease, box-shadow 0.1s ease; }
.hub-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; pointer-events: none; }
.center-icon { font-size: 32px; color: #ff6bad; margin-bottom: -5px; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)); animation: starPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.center-text { font-family: 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Arial', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; color: #ff6bad; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.center-circle:hover { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(255, 105, 180, 0.4); background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #ffffff, #ffccd5); }

#result { font-size: 40px; font-weight: bold; color: #ff6bad; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #ffffff, 0 0 10px rgba(255, 184, 212, 0.5); font-family: 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Varela Round', sans-serif; position: absolute; top: 600px; width: 100%; text-align: center; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important; border: 2px solid #ffb8d4 !important; border-radius: 15px !important; color: #ff6bad !important; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 184, 212, 0.2) !important; pointer-events: none; }
